newsitem.title: MALTA: SOCCER-HUNGARY OVERWHELM MALTA IN WORLD CUP WARM-UP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HUNGARY OVERWHELM MALTA IN WORLD CUP WARM-UP.

text.p: Hungary comfortably beat Malta 4-1 in a soccer friendly on Wednesday - a game used by both teams as preparation for World Cup qualifiers.
Malta, who meet Slovakia at Valletta's Ta'Qali Stadium in group six on March 31, were ineffective on Wednesday, much to the disappointment of the small crowd.
Hungarian coach Janos Csank used all his substitutes as he prepared his team for a difficult group three qualifier in Switzerland on April 30 and can be happy with the overall performance.
Florian Urban opened the scoring for the Hungarians in the 18th minute and Gabor Halmai made it 2-0 five minutes before half time.
Perec Orosz got the third in the 66th and added his second and his team's fourth three minutes from the end.
Malta's consolation was an own goal by Hungarian midfielder Andar Kereszturi who wrong-footed his goalkeeper with a back pass six minutes from time.
